reviewContext.userProblem: In the ERD editor a selected erd.relation (foreign-key) edge does not show which columns it connects, so users cannot see which source and target field rows the relation links.
requiredOutcomes: Selecting an ERD relation edge highlights the background of exactly the source and target field rows it connects; other rows are unaffected (design 2, plans 01-03).
Deselecting the edge or selecting something else removes the highlight (Canvas memo reads signals.selection and signals.rev, plan 03).
Multiple selected relations highlight the union of their connected fields, keyed per table (plan 01).
Relations whose endpoints do not reference specific fields, or whose data is malformed or stale, do not crash and highlight nothing at field level (plan 01).
Unit tests cover erdRelationHighlightedColumns in packages/core/src/erd-foreign-key.test.ts and erdRowHighlighted in packages/ui-solid/src/erd-table-view.test.ts.
bun run typecheck, bun test packages/core packages/ui-solid and mise run lint-ts pass on the combined tree.
nonGoals: Reverse highlight (hover or select a field to highlight its relation lines): erd.table has no field-level hover or selection hook today, so it would need a new interaction model (design 7).
Highlighting through group selection, in ShapePalette, in PrototypePreview, or in SVG/PNG/PDF exports (design 7).
Any change to packages/ir, packages/io, packages/collab, Rust, server code, connector rendering or selection logic.
New CSS variables, a dark-theme block, or renaming the nodetto-erd-row class; apps/desktop/scripts must not change.
constraints: Follow AGENTS.md; no emojis; cargo commands, if any, use CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true.
Highlight is transient view/selection state: never persisted to the document, IR, JSONL, collab doc or exports, and issues no editor command, so it creates no undo history entry.
Resolve columns from existing relation endpoint data via erdEndpointColumnIds (packages/ir/src/semantics.ts:300); do not re-implement the precedence.
Highlight colour derives only from --nodetto-accent (color-mix 18% background plus inset 3px left bar), distinct from .nodetto-selected, the header accent-soft and .nodetto-hover-target.
Strict TypeScript: no any, no non-null assertions on lookups, no prop destructuring in Solid components; self-authored test data only.

Workers edit only their writePaths and their own impl-plans/progress/<planId>.md; fresh read plus sha256 before and after each edit; stop on drift; no state-changing git commands and no worktrees; foreground commands only; scratch only under tmp/erd-highlight-s528/<planId>/.
Wave-1 bun run typecheck failures confined to the sibling plan's files are recorded as drift, never edited; the serial integration gate runs the blocking whole-repo checks.
designDecisionsAndRationale: A pure core helper erdRelationHighlightedColumns(selection, resolve): ReadonlyMap<ElementId, ReadonlySet<string>> in packages/core/src/erd-foreign-key.ts keeps resolution framework-agnostic and unit-testable (design 4.1).
Column ids are filtered against the table's current semantic.columns so stale ids after a rename or delete never highlight (design 2).

Canvas computes one createMemo over signals.rev() and signals.selection() and passes map.get(element.id) through the single renderShape ShapeView call site; cost is O(selected elements + endpoint columns) (design 4.2).
Optional props ShapeViewProps.erdHighlightedColumnIds and ErdTableViewProps.highlightedColumnIds keep ShapePalette and PrototypePreview compiling unchanged (design 4.3).

Row class nodetto-erd-row-related is toggled via classList using the exported pure helper erdRowHighlighted, so rows stay mounted and the decision is testable without mounting components (design 4.3, text-note-view.test.ts pattern).
Logical relations highlight like enforced ones; only resolvability matters (design 2).
intentionalTradeoffs: A relation selected only through a group selection is not highlighted (no group expansion).
Dark-theme readability relies on deriving from --nodetto-accent; no dark block exists today, so none is added. The 18% contrast is not visually verified (residual risk, low).
No Canvas DOM test; Canvas wiring is covered by helper tests, typecheck and grep checks (residual risk, low).
Wave-1 plans run repo-wide typecheck concurrently; sibling errors are recorded, and the serial integration gate re-runs on the combined tree (residual risk, low).
supportedEdgeCases: Single relation with column ends highlights exactly the two column ids.
Composite columns ends, and columns taking precedence over column.
Two selected relations touching one table on different columns give the union.
Self-relation on one table highlights both column sets in that table.
Mixed selection (relation plus table) still highlights the relation's columns.
Empty selection, non-relation selection or unknown ids give an empty map.
Table-level ends, missing table, non-erd.table target, stale column id and malformed semantic (missing from/to or non-object ends): no entry for that end, no throw.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Relations inside a selected group (no group expansion).
Field hover or field selection highlighting relation lines.
Highlight in palette, prototype preview or exports.
